name: Corporate Action Date SD 11
definition: Provides additional information regarding corporate action options date details.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: Xpath to the element that is being extended.

ActualEarlyExpirationDate.name: Actual Early Expiration Date
ActualEarlyExpirationDate.definition: Actual early expiration time as set by the issuer/offer/agent.

ActualProtectExpirationDate.name: Actual Protect Expiration Date
ActualProtectExpirationDate.definition: Last day protect instructions can be submitted to the issuer / agent.

ActualEarlyProtectExpirationDate.name: Actual Early Protect Expiration Date
ActualEarlyProtectExpirationDate.definition: Last day protect instructions can be submitted to the issuer / agent for the early expiration.

DTCEarlyProtectExpirationDate.name: DTC Early Protect Expiration Date
DTCEarlyProtectExpirationDate.definition: Last day protect instructions can be submitted to DTC for the early expiration.

ActualEarlyCoverProtectExpirationDate.name: Actual Early Cover Protect Expiration Date
ActualEarlyCoverProtectExpirationDate.definition: Last day cover early protect instructions can be submitted to the issuer / agent.

DTCEarlyCoverProtectExpirationDate.name: DTC Early Cover Protect Expiration Date
DTCEarlyCoverProtectExpirationDate.definition: Last day cover early protect instructions can be submitted to DTC.

ProcessToDate.name: Process To Date
ProcessToDate.definition: For Reorganization events, date at which instructions will be accepted by agent for payment.

DTCEarliestPaymentDate.name: DTC Earliest Payment Date
DTCEarliestPaymentDate.definition: Date on which DTC expects to receive funds for distribution from the issuer / offeror.  It will be used before payout details are available.
